public_rationale: The conditional forecast cannot yet be scored because its antecedent is not established. Individual failures are documented, but they do not demonstrate material weakening across the relevant startup customer group. The shutdown sample also does not identify that group or its spending with OpenAI and Anthropic. With no deadline and no qualifying conclusive event, the horizon remains open. The conditional-forecast rule requires not_adjudicable while the antecedent is unknown.
limitations: This is not a finding that the forecast failed or that startup customers remained healthy.
The breadth intended by 'begin to falter' materially affects the trigger.
Aggregate revenue growth or new funding would not alone resolve the causal prediction.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If AI startups that integrate these models begin to falter, so will the only real revenue stream OpenAI and Anthropic have, making them more dependent on big tech to keep them alive.
conditions: if AI startups begin to falter

statement.excerpt: If AI startups — by which I mean those companies integrating these models into their apps — begin to falter, so will the only real revenue stream that these companies have, making them more dependent on big tech to keep them alive.

from_speaker: companies integrating these models into their apps
more dependent on big tech to keep them alive
our_interpretation: The model providers referred to are OpenAI and Anthropic.
Read the antecedent as material weakening among the application-startup customer group, rather than an isolated firm's failure. No numerical threshold is supplied.
Read 'only real revenue stream' as the only commercially substantive revenue source, not a denial of every incidental receipt.
The predicted chain is weakening startup customers, weakening provider revenue from those customers, and increased dependence on big-tech support for survival.
The claim has no deadline or specified lag after the triggering downturn.
Revenue and financing must be examined separately. Fundraising alone does not establish survival dependence.
criteria.support_condition: After a documented qualifying downturn, records show that startup integration revenue was the only substantive revenue source for both providers, weakened because of that downturn, and caused greater reliance on big-tech support for survival.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a documented qualifying downturn, sufficiently complete records decisively defeat the predicted chain, including by establishing substantive independent revenue sources and no resulting increase in survival dependence on big tech.
